title: Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
summary: We prove Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for rational simple normal crossing boundaries on compact manifolds in Fujiki class $`\mathcal C`$, including coefficient one. Ordinary and logarithmic subadditivity follow.
family_title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity

review.reason: Proves Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for compact manifolds in Fujiki class C.
